title: TraceLens Incident Event
description: An incident lifecycle event published by TraceLens services.

incidentId.description: Identifier shared by all events in an incident lifecycle.

eventType.description: Lifecycle event type, such as INCIDENT_DETECTED, INCIDENT_UPDATED, or INCIDENT_RESOLVED.

severity.description: Incident severity, such as LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL.

description.description: Human-readable summary of the incident event.

occurredAt.description: Time the event occurred, represented as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
